releaseNotes.0.1.1.0: Automatic component widths for full control-pin labels, plus 10-unit Container and Channel Group connectors with centered labels and pins. Restart Designer; no extra action is needed.
releaseNotes.0.1.2.0:
Q-SYS Mod Manager now enables Automatic Geometry by installing its module and disables it by removing that managed module. This version no longer needs a separate enable-marker file beside Designer. The exact Designer 10.5 build checks remain in place.

Use the manager's previewed update to migrate from an older package and remove its managed legacy marker. Restart Designer after installation.

The catalog listing now uses the supplied Avitex artwork. Its description, image and release notes are owned and published by this repository.

releaseNotes.0.15.0.0: Packing, icon search, editor shortcuts, snapshot indicators, and snapshot value comparison for Q-SYS Designer 10.5. Restart Designer after installation. Open Edit → Schematic Tools to get started.
